messages.subject: Public Hosting issues
parts:
Hello everyone, 

I am new to this package and had a few questions about public hosting. I have been having some issues getting my GUI to work in Shiny. Whenever I run my code my web browser will open a new window and display the survey, but it will not display my GUI. The same issue happens in my viewer window as well. The test will pop up, but it is missing the first-age, last page, etc. The code I have presented (below) is one from a short example to hopefully simplify the process. 

Thank you for all your help!

Best, 

library("mirtCAT")

title <- "Social and Emotional Wellness Screening"
authors <- "Alec"
firstpage <- list(h2("Diabetes Stress"), h5("Please read the following situations and rate how stressful it is; in other words, rate how upsetting, difficult, or how much of a problem each one is for you by checking one of the following:",
                                            "  Not At All; A Little; Pretty Much; Very Much", "There are no right or wrong answers, only what is true for you. Think about each situation and then rate how stressful or how much of a hassle it is for you personally.",))
begin_message <- list(h2("Stress"), h5("Please read the following situations and rate how stressful it is; in other words, rate how upsetting, difficult, or how much of a problem each one is for you by checking one of the following:",
                                                "  Not At All; A Little; Pretty Much; Very Much", "There are no right or wrong answers, only what is true for you. Think about each situation and then rate how stressful or how much of a hassle it is for you personally.",))
lastpage <- function(person){
  est <- extract.mirtCAT(person, 'thetas')
  return(list(h2("Thank you for completing the test."),
              h4('Your final Diabetes Stress estimates are:'),
              h4(sprintf("Diabetes Stress: %.3f, SE = %.3f", person$thetas[1],
                         person$thetas_SE_history[nrow(person$thetas_SE_history), 1])),
             
              # h4(sprintf("Ability two: %.3f, SE = %.3f", person$thetas[2],
              #          person$thetas_SE_history[nrow(person$thetas_SE_history), 2])),
              h3("Please let the clinic know you are done")))
}

instructions <- c("Instructions:   Please read the following situations and rate how stressful it is, then click on the button below.", "Next")
demographics <- list(textInput(inputId = "name", label = "What is your Name?",
                               value = ""), selectInput(inputId = "gender", label = "Please select your gender.",
                                                        choices = c("", "Male", "Female", "Gender Non-Conforming"), selected = ""))
shinyGUI_list <- list(title = title, instructions = instructions, authors = authors, demographics = demographics,
                      demographics_inputIDs = c("name", "gender"), firstpage = firstpage, begin_message= 'Please read the following situations and rate how stressful it is. Please click next to begin', lastpage = lastpage)
# run the customized GUI interface

options(stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

# simple interface, no stems
options <- matrix(c("Strongly Disagree", "Disagree", "Neutral", "Agree", "Strongly Agree"),
                  nrow = 3, ncol = 5, byrow = TRUE)
questions <- c("Building CATs with mirtCAT is difficult.",
               "mirtCAT requires a substantial amount of coding.",
               "I would use mirtCAT in my research.")
df <- data.frame(Question = questions, Option = options, Type = "radio")

results <- mirtCAT(df = df)
summary(results)

## two step hosting
sessionName <- 'My session'
my_fun <- function(person) cat('Hello world')
mirtCAT_preamble(sessionName=sessionName, df=df, final_fun = my_fun)
runApp(createShinyGUI(), port = 8000)
person <- getPerson()
summary(person)
